Also, MCL injuries — especially grade I/II — rarely present *without any swelling or effusion*, but more importantly, they do not produce *focal joint line tenderness* as a primary sign; that is a meniscal red flag. No finding contradicts meniscal tear; all “absences” (no effusion, no fracture, etc.) are *expected* in early or non-displaced meniscal tears. McMurray test is unreported — neither supportive nor contradictory. Pending MRI is consistent with diagnostic uncertainty *only at the soft-tissue level*, not at the level of differential plausibility.
